_comment: Absolute/relative tolerances per quantity, comparison and computational variant, fixed in advance. Bit equality where proven and required (41.51 refactor); the RWS migration has its own documented residuals, not an automatic tolerance.

fork_4151_vs_upstream_4151._comment: Holds since BF-63 only when the fork computes the LTA as upstream does (TRIAD ... UPSTREAM); with the deck as it is, the fork differs by up to 2.5 cm in Hsig. Measured on 10 November 2026 at u20_d310_lp300_open, upstream 43e9bbb and the fork at commit aea2500 with UPSTREAM, both built with gfortran 16.2 at -O3 and run with four OpenMP threads pinned to four logical CPUs (two cores): the same accuracy at every iteration, and table and spectra byte-identical, except at the five output points that only the fork finds (BF-56), where upstream writes exception values and NODATA. The deck writes no field, so Hsig_field was not compared.

legacy_4131_vs_RWS4131._comment: Report only. No migration tolerance is fixed in advance; formal sign-off requires a run of the full condition matrix.

optimization_levels_O0_O2_O3._comment: A Debug build (-O0) with gfortran 16.2 passes every test against the -O3 references; no tolerance is widened for it.
